description: React functional component named Sparkline that renders a small inline SVG sparkline graph for visualization of time-series data. Accepts data points, size, stroke, fill, and accessibility label as props.

methods.name: Sparkline({ values, width = 180, height = 48, stroke = 'var(--color-primary)', fill = 'none', 'aria-label': ariaLabel = 'trend line', })
methods.description: React component rendering an accessible, dependency-free SVG sparkline for small time-series data visualization.
parameters: values: array of data points (numbers or { t: number, v: number })
width: width of SVG in pixels
height: height of SVG in pixels
stroke: stroke color for the line
fill: fill color under the curve
ariaLabel: accessible label for the SVG
